entities.name: Sky Tyrant
entities.description: The red moon of Mirrodin shining over the Oxidda Chain, composed of red mana; now orbits Zhalfir.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: Plane whose red moon was Sky Tyrant.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountain range over which Sky Tyrant shone.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Mirrodin's Goblins, who revered Sky Tyrant and held wild festivals.

entities.name: Steel Mother
entities.description: Figure whose body Goblins believed Sky Tyrant forged with a hammer.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: Lacuna of the sun on Mirrodin.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Ended with New Phyrexia phasing out.

events.summary: After New Phyrexia phases out at the end of the invasion, Sky Tyrant orbits Zhalfir.
events.quote: It now orbits Zhalfir after New Phyrexia's phasing out at the end of the New Phyrexian Invasion .
